patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with a large, left-aligned text block and a prominent, right-aligned illustrative graphic.
Extremely large, high-contrast sans-serif headings dominate the hero section, creating a strong visual impact.
A clean, near-monochromatic base of light gray and black is accented by a vibrant, multi-color rainbow gradient and a distinct purple for primary calls to action.

The navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay with white text/logo to an opaque bar with a light background and dark logo/text upon scrolling down the page. A rainbow gradient bar remains fixed at the very top of the viewport.
A dedicated 'Trusted By' section immediately follows the hero, presenting a grid of partner logos with a minimal, clean aesthetic.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that changes its background, text color, and logo color/variant on scroll past a certain threshold, while a fixed rainbow gradient bar remains at the absolute top of the viewport.

Create a dynamic 3D wireframe object using a canvas library and animate its properties (e.g., rotation, subtle pulsing) potentially with GSAP, positioning it as a large, illustrative element in the hero section.

Utilize a single sans-serif font family with extreme weight variations for a strong typographic hierarchy, featuring very large, bold headings and clear, readable body text, with uppercase used for navigation and some labels.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text size) with clear, readable body text and uppercase navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and input fields (e.g., 4-8px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with an airy hero section and consistent vertical rhythm for content blocks.

standout: The combination of the striking, large-scale 3D wireframe graphic in the hero, the bold, almost brutalist typography, and the subtle yet ever-present rainbow gradient bar creates a distinctive high-tech, sophisticated, and slightly playful aesthetic.
